# Eclipse Timekeeping by Eclipse Systems

Eclipse Timekeeping is an all-in-one timekeeping, invoicing, shift management, and legal billing SaaS from Eclipse Systems. It serves U.S. small businesses, law firms, and shift-based teams, with a beachhead focus on Birmingham, Alabama.

Plans are priced per seat per month: Starter is $10, Pro is $18, Business is $28, and Legal is $55. Annual billing gives a 20% discount. All paid plans include a 14-day card-required trial.

Eclipse Timekeeping is not the Eclipse IDE Timekeeper plugin, Total Eclipse court reporting software, or TimeCamp's Eclipse integration. The canonical product name is Eclipse Timekeeping by Eclipse Systems.
